name: RC-B10-0335/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the June 2025 suicide attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus, which killed at least 25 people. It also condemns violence against Alawites, Druze and other religious and ethnic groups in Syria. It calls on Syria's transitional authorities to protect all communities, investigate attacks and prosecute those responsible. It asks the European Union to keep and add targeted sanctions, and to set up a reconstruction fund for Syria only if human rights progress is shown. This is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands better protection, investigations and accountability from Syria's transitional authorities.
- It affects Syria's religious and ethnic minorities, especially Christians, and the Syrian authorities.
- The European Union is asked to add sanctions and link a reconstruction fund to human rights progress.
